reviewItem.question: Does "Add `CAInjectorMerging` feature gate to the ca-injector, enabling this will change the behavior of the ca-injector to merge in new CA certificates instead of…" mean a change to feature-gate:cert-manager|name=CAInjectorMerging|component=ca-injector (added)?

proposed.statement: A new CAInjectorMerging feature gate is added to the ca-injector; when enabled, the injector merges new CA certificates instead of replacing the existing one.
